review: Reviewed InstalledServicesPanel changed hunks, read/mutation lifecycle and rendering, its complete suite, and the complete small AgentAccessPanel composition. Read the SPB-3 authority contract; this cohort does not change native/server MFA or receipt semantics.

Installed services distinguish personal OpenAI/Gemini keys from provider-broker enrollment, sandbox billing, registered device status, exact Codex grants and program authority. The overview now uses the current security observation for registration. Opening key settings remains an explicit action; account notifications close the dialog.

Reproduced five failures: stale installed account projections across profile replacement, late step-up responses opening the native browser after replacement/unmount, and late native failures cancelling requests in a newer context. A profile-revision keyed inner panel resets observations and drafts. Operation epochs suppress stale browser opens, cancellation follow-ups, UI completions and security reloads after replacement/unmount.

A sixth regression preserves the selected tab when an account notification does not change identity. Existing native approval, cancellation, payment-change and routing tests continue to pass with mocks.

Agent Access places the existing setup inbox and connection-health panel before personal/local setup and keeps manual guidance in a disclosure. It is compiled but this cohort does not mount its full integration.
limits: Private unfrozen source proposal; no public publication or native account/MFA/payment action.

Twenty-one mocked installed-service tests exercise UI. They do not establish live Auth0 enrollment, token custody, server cross-account enforcement, funded billing, installed or signed-update acceptance.

The new guards do not cancel an already-issued server intent or native operation. Server expiry and owner-bound native validation remain authoritative. Same-profile session replacement and native completion-event identity attribution remain separate qualification.

LiveConnectionSettings, GeminiConnectionSettings, ConnectionHealthPanel, AgentAccessGuide and account-policy/shared dependencies remain separate source review. Tests use canonical versions of omitted dependencies; no full application build.
Five intentional support-contact matches inherited from the previous candidate remain in the final owner publication review.
